name: Policy_Settings
_about: Control Panel, Delivery group (spec 05 Shared Engines / 08). The catalogue of Delivery settings (label, default, min, max, what it affects) lives in server/modules/delivery-management/settings-defs.mjs; a row here only stores a changed value. No row = the default. Every change of a catalogue key is written to Delivery_Settings_History by server/modules/delivery-management/settings.mjs.

fields.name: Change_Reason
fields.label: Reason for the change
fields.helpText: Optional. Kept in the Delivery Settings history. Only used for a key from the Delivery catalogue.
